blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Kai Oani erupted for a career-high 33 points as Ateneo routed University of the East, 90-62, to secure at least a playoff for fourth place in the UAAP Season 89 women’s basketball tournament on Saturday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. After opening the season with two straight losses, the Blue Eagles finished the elimination round at 8-6, winning five of their seven games in the second round. They will await the result of the UP-NU matchup to determine their postseason fate. Oani shot 12-of-14 from the field, including 8-of-10 from 3-point range, […]...
